name: Shopify Competitor Price Drop, MAP & Restock Alerts to Slack, Gmail & Sheets

parameters.content:
## Shopify Competitor Price, MAP & Restock Monitor (Zero-Proxy)

Monitors competitor Shopify catalogs on a 6-hour schedule, filters out unchanged/baseline runs, scores alert severity (`CRITICAL`, `INVENTORY`, `CATALOG`), logs every real change to Google Sheets, and routes urgent MAP violations or >=15% price drops to `#pricing-alerts` + Gmail while sending stock/catalog alerts to `#ecom-ops`.

**Actor URL:** https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/shopify-competitor-delta-monitor
**GitHub MCP & Kit:** https://github.com/wonderpick/apify-b2b-ecom-automation-kit
**Cost:** $2.00 / 1,000 real deltas · **$0 on baseline or unchanged runs** · 128–256 MB RAM · $0 proxy.

### 1. Dynamic Config (Google Sheets -> Batch Payload)

Create a spreadsheet with two tabs:
- **`Config`**: columns `storeUrl`, optional `sku` (or `handle`), optional `mapPrice`, optional `minPriceChangePercent`, optional `maxProductsPerStore`.
- **`DeltaHistory`**: columns `detectedAt`, `severity`, `eventType`, `store`, `title`, `variantTitle`, `sku`, `oldPrice`, `newPrice`, `priceChangePercent`, `available`, `mapViolation`, `productUrl`.

Select your Google Sheets OAuth credential on both Google Sheets nodes.

### 2. Zero-Proxy Delta Engine & Severity Scoring

1. Create a free [Apify account](https://apify.com) and generate an API token (`Settings -> API & Integrations`).
2. Create an n8n **Header Auth** credential (`Name`: `Authorization`, `Value`: `Bearer <your_apify_token>`) and attach it to **Run Shopify Competitor Delta Monitor**.
3. Unchanged catalogs and initial baselines are filtered out automatically before alerting.

### 3. Multi-Channel Routing & Audit Log

- **All real deltas** are appended to `DeltaHistory` in Google Sheets.
- **CRITICAL** (`mapViolation === true` or `priceChangePercent <= -15`) -> Slack `#pricing-alerts` + Gmail escalation.
- **INVENTORY** (`restocked`, `out_of_stock`) & **CATALOG** (`new_product`, `discount_started`, minor price updates) -> Slack `#ecom-ops`.
